about.text: Germany’s everyday soured cream, sold as Saure Sahne or Sauerrahm: cream soured with lactic acid bacteria to at least 10 % fat, and not heated again after souring.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream is soured with a mesophilic starter and sold without heating afterwards, so the culture stays alive. Same entry as Sauerrahm and Sahnesauermilch.
